summary: Expeditors International filed an 8-K on May 5, 2026, announcing a semi-annual cash dividend of $0.81 per share declared May 4, 2026, payable June 15, 2026 to holders of record June 1, 2026. This represents a 5% increase from prior dividends. The company also highlighted a new $3 billion share repurchase program authorized in February 2026 and cumulative returns of nearly $2 billion to shareholders since 2024. No board recommendation or advisor was named. The filing is a routine dividend declaration and ongoing buyback program disclosure. What to watch: no risk-arb angle; this is a steady capital return policy.
